subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic plugin reaction hooks for Discord now, and if so what public hook names, payload fields, and cross-channel scope should become the supported SDK contract?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix adds public plugin API surface and the discussion raises unresolved choices around generic versus channel-specific names, structured emoji payloads, lazy enrichment, and whether Discord should land before Slack/Matrix/WhatsApp parity.

options.title: Add generic observation hooks
options.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as typed observation hooks with a structured, channel-tagged payload and Discord wiring first, leaving other channels to adopt the same contract later.

options.title: Defer for cross-channel design
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers settle a multi-channel reaction hook payload across Discord, Slack, Matrix, and WhatsApp before any SDK addition.

options.title: Keep reactions as system events only
options.body: Decline new plugin hook surface and direct plugin authors to consume routed system events or the separate wake-policy work instead.

recommendation.title: Add generic observation hooks
recommendation.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as typed observation hooks with a structured, channel-tagged payload and Discord wiring first, leaving other channels to adopt the same contract later.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is recent ownership of the Discord reaction listener/system-event path and adjacent Discord docs/source work.
